meta.title: About Travel Buddy
meta.description: A global travel guide and community built around privacy, honesty and real connections.

about.title: Travel is better shared
about.p1: Travel Buddy brings together destination discovery, AI trip planning and a community of travelers in one place, on the web and on our iOS and Android apps.
about.p2: We believe the best trips combine great information with great people, so we design for both.

principles.privacy: Privacy by default: no exact locations, discovery is opt-in, and you decide who can reach you.
principles.honesty: No invented facts: we don’t present unverified opening hours, prices or travel rules as truth.
principles.safety: Safety for everyone: blocking, reporting and moderation are free and always available.
principles.everywhere: Everywhere you are: one account across web, iOS and Android, in your language.

legal.draftBody: This page summarises our product commitments. The binding legal text will be published here after legal review.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.summary: Travel Buddy is for adults aged 18 and over. You keep ownership of what you post, choose who can see it, and agree to follow our community guidelines.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: We never store your exact device location. Nearby features use a rounded, request-scoped position. Traveler discovery is off by default and shows only a city or neighbourhood. You can export or delete your data.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.summary: We use strictly necessary cookies for sign-in and security, plus a cookie to remember your language. No third-party tracking runs without your consent.

guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.summary: Be respectful, be honest and keep others safe. Harassment, hate, scams and sharing other people’s private information are not allowed and can be reported.
